# Step 7: Cyanobacteria and its uses; 

Inference of separate metabolic pathways based on processes like photosynthesis and sulfate reduction; Tool used= minpath

```bash
head ../prokka/metabat.57/metabat.57.tsv | awk -F '\t' '{print $1,$5}'
```

## Questions (4.1):
1) How many bins contain at least one gene from this pathway?
2) Which bin has all of the genes (i.e, a complete pathway)?

## Answers (4.1):
1) 3 bins; namely metabat16, metabat31 and metabat57
2) metabat57


## Questions (4.2):
1) How many bins contain the pathway PWY-5360?
2) What family (in a taxonomic sense) do these bins belong to?

## Answers (4.2):
1) 3 bins; namely metabat42, metabat9 and metabat31
2)  - metabat42: Desulfovibrionaceae
    - metabat9: Desulforegulaceae
    - metabat31: Desulforegulaceae
